prompts.name: pc-assistant
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: project cover for a developer portfolio. Premium editorial 3D illustration with realistic materials, consistent retro-futurist aesthetic. Dark teal #002626 backdrop, teal #0e4749 shadows, warm ivory #efe7da objects, restrained lime #95c623 and burnt orange #e55812 accents. Soft studio lighting, refined textures, calm uncluttered composition. Landscape 3:2 image, important subject in central 65% so it survives wide 1.9:1 and square crops. Keep top-left quiet for a small HTML project label. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logos, no fabricated application screenshots. Primary request: cover for an AI assistant that advises on selecting parts for a future desktop PC. A neatly arranged miniature desktop computer assembly, ivory PC case, graphics card, motherboard and memory modules, with a small floating speech bubble containing only a simple glowing light shape. Tangible precise computer components, readable central visual hierarchy.
